fact_or_fake: Honey never spoils, even after thousands of years.
Archaeologists have found edible honey in ancient Egyptian tombs.
Goldfish have a memory span of only three seconds.
Goldfish can actually remember things for months, not seconds.
The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
It's too narrow to be seen without aid from low Earth orbit.
A group of flamingos is called a 'flamboyance'.
That's the official collective noun for flamingos.
Humans only use 10% of their brains.
Brain scans show we use virtually all of our brain, just not all at once.
Bananas are botanically classified as berries.
They meet the botanical definition, unlike strawberries.
Lightning never strikes the same place twice.
The Empire State Building is struck around 20-25 times a year.
Octopuses have three hearts.
Two pump blood to the gills, one to the rest of the body.
The Eiffel Tower can grow taller in the summer heat.
Thermal expansion can add several centimeters to its height.
Sharks existed before trees.
Sharks predate trees by around 50 million years.
Cracking your knuckles causes arthritis.
Studies have found no link between knuckle cracking and arthritis.
Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system.
Its thick atmosphere traps heat, making it hotter than Mercury.
You swallow eight spiders a year in your sleep on average.
This is an urban myth with no scientific basis.
The shortest war in history lasted under 40 minutes.
The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 lasted about 38 minutes.
Diamonds are made from compressed coal.
Diamonds form from carbon much deeper and older than coal deposits.
A day on Venus is longer than its year.
Venus rotates so slowly that its day outlasts its orbit.
Napoleon Bonaparte was unusually short for his time.
He was about average height for a Frenchman of his era.
Wearing headphones for an hour can increase ear bacteria significantly.
Studies show a notable increase in bacteria in warm, enclosed ear spaces.
The Sahara Desert is the largest desert in the world.
Antarctica is technically the largest desert by area.
Polar bears have black skin under their white fur.
Their skin is black to help absorb heat from the sun.
Einstein failed math in school.
He excelled at math from a young age; this is a popular myth.
It rains diamonds on Jupiter and Saturn.
Scientists believe extreme pressure turns carbon into diamonds there.
The human body has enough iron to make a small nail.
The iron content in blood is roughly enough for a 3-inch nail.
Chameleons change color mainly to blend into their surroundings.
They mostly change color to regulate temperature and communicate.
Mount Everest is the tallest mountain measured base to peak.
Mauna Kea in Hawaii is taller when measured from base to summit.
Butterflies can taste with their feet.
Taste receptors on their feet help them find host plants.
The inventor of the Pringles can is buried in one.
Fredric Baur's ashes were partly buried in a Pringles can per his wishes.
All 50 U.S. states have a McDonald's.
Vermont's last McDonald's location closed for a period, breaking full coverage.
Cats can't taste sweetness.
Cats lack the taste receptor gene for sweet flavors.
The inventor of the frisbee was turned into a frisbee after he died.
Walter Morrison's ashes were molded into frisbee discs, per his wishes.

fact_or_fake: A bolt of lightning is hotter than the surface of the sun.
Lightning can reach about 30,000 Kelvin, hotter than the sun's surface.
Ostriches bury their heads in the sand when scared.
They actually lower their heads to the ground to check on eggs or flee.
The human nose can detect over a trillion different scents.
Research suggests humans can distinguish over a trillion odors.
Bats are blind.
Most bats can see, and some have excellent night vision.
A single cloud can weigh over a million pounds.
A typical cumulus cloud can weigh more than a million pounds due to water droplets.
The Statue of Liberty was originally brown.
It was copper-colored before oxidizing to its current green patina.
Peanuts are technically nuts.
Peanuts are legumes, not true nuts.
There are more stars in the universe than grains of sand on Earth.
Estimates put star counts far higher than total grains of sand.
Humans and dinosaurs coexisted at some point.
Dinosaurs went extinct about 66 million years before humans existed.
A snail can sleep for up to three years.
Snails can enter long dormant states, especially in harsh conditions.
The tongue has specific zones for sweet, sour, salty, and bitter tastes.
Taste buds for all flavors are spread across the whole tongue, not zoned.
It is impossible to hum while holding your nose closed.
Humming is possible with your nose closed; it just changes the sound slightly.
The inventor of the microwave oven discovered it by accident.
Percy Spencer noticed a candy bar melted near an active radar set.
Elephants are the only mammals that can't jump.
Their leg structure doesn't allow for the push-off needed to jump.
The Amazon rainforest produces about 20% of the world's oxygen.
Its net oxygen contribution is close to zero, though it's still vital to biodiversity.
A rainbow can only be seen if the sun is behind you.
Rainbows form opposite the sun's position relative to the observer.
Koalas are technically a type of bear.
Koalas are marsupials, not bears at all.
The Great Fire of London in 1666 killed thousands of people.
Official records list only a handful of confirmed deaths.
Human teeth are just as strong as shark teeth.
Shark teeth are far more durable and self-replacing than human teeth.
Some turtles can breathe through their butts.
Certain turtle species absorb oxygen through their cloaca while submerged.
The Mona Lisa has eyebrows.
The famous painting shows no visible eyebrows, possibly faded over time.
It's impossible for a cow to walk down stairs.
Cows can walk down stairs; they just struggle more due to their knee structure.
Venus is the only planet that spins clockwise.
Venus rotates in the opposite direction from most other planets.
Sea otters hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart.
They link paws or wrap in kelp to stay together while floating.
The world's oceans contain enough gold to give everyone on Earth several kilograms.
Trace amounts of dissolved gold exist throughout ocean water, though extraction isn't practical.
Albert Einstein won a Nobel Prize for his theory of relativity.
His Nobel Prize was for the photoelectric effect, not relativity.
A hummingbird's heart can beat over 1,200 times per minute.
Their tiny hearts beat extremely fast to support rapid wing movement.
The longest recorded flight of a chicken is over a minute.
Chickens can only fly for a few seconds at most, covering short distances.
Antarctica is classified as a desert.
It receives very little precipitation, meeting the technical definition of a desert.
The five-second rule makes dropped food safe to eat.
Bacteria can transfer to food almost instantly upon contact with a surface.

fact_or_fake: Cleopatra lived closer in time to the Moon landing than to the building of the Great Pyramid.
The pyramids were built ~2560 BC; Cleopatra lived ~30 BC, closer to 1969 than to the pyramids.
The unicorn is the national animal of Scotland.
Scotland has officially used the unicorn as its national animal since the 1300s.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire.
Teaching began at Oxford around 1096, while the Aztec Empire started around 1428.
A blue whale's heart is roughly the size of a small car.
Blue whale hearts can weigh around 400 pounds and are famously huge.
The first oranges were originally orange in color.
The earliest oranges were actually green; the color name came later.
Table tennis was originally called 'whiff-whaff'.
Early versions of ping pong were called by names like whiff-whaff in the 1800s.
Scotland has more redheads per capita than any other country.
Scotland is widely cited as having the highest percentage of natural redheads.
The inventor of the Erector Set also invented the artificial heart.
The Erector Set inventor did not invent the artificial heart; this is a myth.
Some cats are allergic to humans.
Cats can develop allergic reactions to human skin cells, similarly to how humans react to pets.
There's a species of jellyfish that is biologically immortal.
Turritopsis dohrnii can revert to an earlier life stage, essentially avoiding aging death.
The Twitter bird has an official name.
The bird was officially named 'Larry' by Twitter before the platform's rebrand.
Coca-Cola was originally green.
Coca-Cola has always been brown/caramel colored, not green.
Scotland's national motto includes a warning in Latin roughly meaning 'no one provokes me with impunity'.
This is the country's official motto, tied to the unicorn and thistle.
The dot over a lowercase 'i' or 'j' has a specific name.
It's called a 'tittle'.
A shrimp's heart is located in its head.
A shrimp's heart is located near its head, not in its thorax like many other creatures.
Bananas grow on trees.
Banana plants are technically giant herbs, not trees.
The Eiffel Tower was originally intended to be temporary.
It was built for the 1889 World's Fair and almost dismantled after 20 years.
Almonds are part of the peach family.
Almonds are classified in the same plant family as peaches and plums.
The world's first computer programmer was a man.
Ada Lovelace, a woman, is widely credited as the first computer programmer.
Wombat poop is cube-shaped.
Wombats produce distinctively cube-shaped droppings.
The Titanic had a sister ship that also sank.
Its sister ship Olympic had a long career and never sank.
A jiffy is an actual unit of time.
A jiffy is defined in physics as a very short, specific unit of time.
The inventor of the Ferris Wheel was named George Ferris.
George Washington Gale Ferris Jr. invented the original Ferris Wheel.
It's illegal to own just one guinea pig in Switzerland.
Swiss animal welfare laws require guinea pigs to have companionship.
The letter 'Q' is not used in any U.S. state name.
No U.S. state name contains the letter Q.
A 'group of pandas' is called an 'embarrassment'.
That's the official collective noun for pandas.
Mount Everest's height is fixed and never changes.
Its height changes slightly due to tectonic activity and snow measurement variance.
The dot on top of an exclamation point has no special name.
Like the tittle on 'i' and 'j', the dot has its own terminology in typography.
Honeybees can recognize human faces.
Studies show honeybees can be trained to distinguish between human faces.
The first product with a barcode scanned at a store was a pack of gum.
A pack of Wrigley's chewing gum was the first barcoded item scanned in 1974.

fact_or_fake: The inventor of the telephone, Alexander Graham Bell, never called his own mother or wife on the phone.
Both his mother and wife were deaf, so he never called them.
A crocodile cannot stick its tongue out.
A crocodile's tongue is held in place by a membrane, preventing it from extending.
Some fish can climb trees.
The mudskipper can climb trees and survive out of water for extended periods.
The shortest commercial flight in the world lasts under two minutes.
A flight between two Scottish islands takes under two minutes in good conditions.
The Eiffel Tower is the most visited paid monument in the world.
The Great Wall of China and other sites see far more visitors.
Slugs have four noses.
Slugs technically have four sensory tentacles used for smell.
You can hear a blue whale's call from over 500 miles away underwater.
Blue whale calls can travel extremely long distances through water.
The first alarm clock could only ring at one specific time.
Early mechanical alarm clocks were fixed to ring at 4am only.
The Amazon River has no bridges crossing it.
Due to its remote path through rainforest, no bridges cross the main Amazon River.
A shrimp can't swim backwards.
Shrimp can rapidly flick their tails to shoot backwards through water.
The word 'set' has the most different meanings of any English word.
The Oxford English Dictionary lists 'set' with the most definitions of any word.
There are more possible iterations of a chess game than atoms in the observable universe.
The number of possible chess games vastly exceeds estimated atom counts.
Astronauts can grow taller in space.
Reduced gravity allows the spine to elongate slightly during spaceflight.
The longest wedding veil was longer than 60 football fields.
A record-setting wedding veil measured longer than 60 soccer pitches combined.
Cows have best friends and get stressed when separated.
Studies show cows form close bonds and show stress indicators when separated.
The inventor of the Frisbee died before it became popular.
Walter Morrison lived to see the Frisbee become a huge commercial success.
It's physically impossible to lick your own elbow.
Most people's arm and shoulder structure prevents reaching the elbow with the tongue.
A group of crows is called a 'murder'.
That's the traditional collective noun for crows.
The Statue of Liberty's official name is 'Liberty Enlightening the World'.
That is its full official French-origin name.
Penguins propose to their mates with a pebble.
Some penguin species, like Gentoos, present pebbles as part of courtship.
The longest living land animal is the elephant.
Giant tortoises typically live far longer than elephants.
There's a basketball court inside the U.S. Supreme Court building.
It's informally nicknamed 'the highest court in the land'.
The dot of a lowercase 'i' was originally added for decoration.
The dot was added to help distinguish the letter in cursive medieval handwriting.
The Mona Lisa is painted on canvas.
It's painted on a poplar wood panel, not canvas.
A rhinoceros horn is made of the same material as human hair.
Rhino horns are composed of keratin, the same protein as hair and nails.
The longest engagement in recorded history lasted over 60 years.
A record-setting couple stayed engaged for decades before marrying.
The Sahara Desert was once a lush green landscape.
Thousands of years ago the Sahara had lakes, rivers, and vegetation.
Kangaroos can't walk backwards.
Their leg structure and tail make backward walking essentially impossible.
The dot-com boom began before the internet was invented.
The internet existed for decades before the dot-com boom of the late 1990s.
You can't hum with your nose plugged if your mouth is also closed.
Humming is a nasal sound and still works even with the mouth closed.
